runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you head to The Hermitage.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A quick runner checklist for packet pickup, course rules, included items, and race-day logistics.

items.label: Packet pick-up
items.detail: Packet pick-up is listed for Friday, October 16 from 10:30 AM–6:30 PM at Fleet Feet Mt. Juliet, or race morning from 6:45–7:45 AM at Andrew Jackson’s Hermitage.

items.label: Course surface
items.detail: The course is described as cross-country with beautiful fields, grass, a small portion of trail, and paved road.

items.label: Timing
items.detail: The official pages state the race is not chip-timed and will use a rolling time clock.

items.label: Included items
items.detail: The first 300 registrants receive a custom medal and a Grounds Pass to The Hermitage, valid through October 17, 2027.

items.label: Shirt deadline
items.detail: Register by September 14, 2026 to receive the listed commemorative race T-shirt.

items.label: Course rules
items.detail: Strollers are not recommended and should start at the back if used. Dogs are not allowed on the course during the race, though leashed dogs are welcome on the included Grounds Pass visit after the event.

story.title: Run through a National Historic Landmark before the grounds open for the day.
paragraphs: The 7th President 7K brings runners and walkers onto the grounds of Andrew Jackson’s Hermitage for a cross-country race morning across paved paths, open fields, and historic landmarks.

The route is promoted around signature Hermitage places — Tulip Grove Mansion, Hermitage Church, and the Hermitage Mansion finish setting — giving participants a race-day view of areas visitors do not always experience the same way.
All proceeds benefit the Andrew Jackson Foundation’s work to preserve The Hermitage, create educational opportunities, and inspire informed citizenship.
story.quote: More than 300 runners (and walkers) registered for the race—spanning 19 states and two foreign countries!

faqs.question: What events are offered?
faqs.answer: RunSignup lists the 5th Annual 7th President 7K Run and the 5th Annual 7th President 2 Mile Walk.

faqs.question: Where is the race?
faqs.answer: The race is at Andrew Jackson’s Hermitage, 4580 Rachel’s Lane, Nashville, TN 37076.

faqs.question: When does the race start?
faqs.answer: Both listed events start at 8:00 AM CDT on Saturday, October 17, 2026.

faqs.question: Is the race chip-timed?
faqs.answer: No. The official pages say the event is not chip-timed and will use a rolling time clock.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: The RunSignup refund policy page states refunds are not allowed for this race.

faqs.question: Are dogs or strollers allowed?
faqs.answer: Dogs are not allowed on the course during the race. Strollers are not recommended because the course includes unpaved areas; if used, the organizer asks participants to start at the back.
